behaviours.note: The first run reported FAIL because the verifier regex assumed hex; the hash is base64url (HMAC). Re-checked from the database afterwards: both keys match ^rl:quote(-coupon)?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$, none contains the guessed code text or a long digit run.

behaviours.label: migration commercial_rules is live: ServiceOffering, Coupon, CouponBranch, CommercialSettings exist; settings row id=default seeded at 1500
behaviours.evidence: to_regclass on the disposable database returned all four tables; SELECT id, vatRateBasisPoints -> default|1500; prisma migrate deploy on a scratch database applied 8 migrations and 'prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code' printed 'No difference detected.'

behaviours.label: bucket cleanup job prunes expired quote and quote-coupon buckets
behaviours.evidence: aged the two quote buckets by 2 days, ran 'npm run throttles -- cleanup-public' -> {"deleted":3}; remaining rl:quote% rows = 0

behaviours.label: LIMIT_REACHED and PHONE_LIMIT_REACHED through the running app
behaviours.evidence: NOT EXERCISED LIVE by design: redemption counts are zero until M8 (spec 0004 Decision 4), so the API cannot reach those two reasons. Covered by unit tests only: tests/unit/domain/coupon-policy.test.ts and tests/unit/application/quote-booking.test.ts.
